latest_autonomous_wave.title: Crash-Safe Cancel-During-Start Relaunch Recovery
latest_autonomous_wave.goal: Close the MOI-P020 relaunch seam where a durable cancellationRequested record can have no provider job binding after app termination during start().
latest_autonomous_wave.rationale: Before A39, cancellationRequested was grouped with normal bound active jobs during generic relaunch recovery. If cancellation was persisted while start() was in flight and the app terminated before jobID binding, recovery could fall into PROC_JOB_BINDING_MISSING even though the provider may already have accepted the start. Blind retry could create a duplicate or strand billable work. The existing stable-idempotent resolver already preserves cancellation intent, so A39 composes that primitive with lifecycle recovery rather than duplicating it.
latest_autonomous_wave.done_when: starting/startAmbiguous/cancellationRequested records with jobID=nil are treated as start ambiguity; stable-idempotent providers may rebind the same generation before canonical recovery; cancellation intent is preserved through rebound and remote cancel; providers without stable resolution remain fail-closed; non-mutating preview never enters generic missing-binding recovery; regression/evidence/status and HQ integration requirements are durable.
